name: Bedrock Riven
description: Chop down into the middle of the opponent's stance as if pouring weight into a basin.

name: Spectral Haftbell
description: Pivot along the wall of the basin so that the body stays on the rim of the foe's reach.

name: Revelation Doubleedge
description: Fix a calm gaze on the foe and read the line of their shoulders against the sky.

name: Longhelve Banner
description: Hew along the lip of the foe's stance with qi in the edge to break the rim.

name: Deluge Haftrope
description: Turn the haft like the curve of a basin wall and send a blow around the body.

name: Volition Poleshoe
description: Hold the axe overhead like a hawk's shadow so that the foe dares not rise from the basin.

name: Sovereign Wideswell
description: Cleave down into the foe's stance and let the full body's weight and qi flood in behind the edge.

name: Inferno Greatbit
description: Fall upon the rim of the guard with a crushing weight that drives the whole stance downward.

name: Rendverdict
description: Rend the basin of the foe's stance with a fall that the field drives through guard and ground.

name: Exalted Bedrock Greatpoll
description: The school's own stroke: a held overhead lift released as one great fall that fills the whole basin of the foe's stance.

name: Haemalaxe
description: Chop overhead on the first track while the lead foot lays the second beneath the swing.

name: Deluge Hewfall
description: Cross from one track to the other with a single measured pace and no loss of balance.

name: Magnanimous Greatbeard
description: Hold both of the opponent's lines in view and judge which will carry the blow.

name: Haemal Rend
description: Chain hews along both tracks with qi following the edge from one line to the next.

name: Delugeaxe
description: Parry on the crossing of the tracks and turn the blow onto the unused line.

name: Pealsunder
description: Hook the beard on the near track and drag the opponent's weapon onto the far one.

name: Gloomsunder
description: Hold the head down on the opponent's guard while the feet take the second track.

name: Storied Sunder
description: Hew along both tracks in a single heavy stroke so that qi arrives from two directions at once.

name: Haemalriven
description: Fall at the point where the tracks cross so that the weight of both lands as one.

name: Vacuum Longhelve
description: Rend a guard with qi arriving from both tracks and passing together through the same cut.

name: Storied Squall Splitmass
description: The school's own stroke: a single heavy cut that carries the weight of both tracks to a single point of the target.

name: Vigorsunder
description: Chop along a line the stroke has already worn through the opponent's guard.

name: Silken Greatbit
description: Step along the bank of the cut where the ground is firm and the foe's footing is not.

name: Revelation Haftbell
description: Read where the foe's force is flowing so that the next cut may be laid across it.

name: Splitmass Banner
description: Hew into the same groove twice so that qi opens it further with each pass.

name: Axeseal
description: Meet an attack with the haft and let the current of the stroke carry it past the body.

name: Season Sunder
description: Hold the head across the foe's path like a weir so that no blow of theirs can pass.

name: Sunderdecree
description: Hew with the full body behind it and cut through a guard in one smooth heavy channel.

name: Thunderclap Heavyeye
description: Fall with the force of a spate in full flood and crush whatever guard is raised against it.

name: Sunderverdict
description: Part the foe's guard as a river parts stone with qi pressed along the whole edge.

name: Hewfall Crown
description: The school's own stroke: a slow-gathered cut that digs its own path through the guard as it falls.

name: Squall Greatbeard
description: Open the court with a measured chop that sets the first mark on the floor.

name: Bedrock Wideswell
description: Take each step to a mark upon the floor of the court so the axe always lands in order.

name: Prismgreat
description: Hold the axe edge-up before the body to stop a descending blow at the line of the court.

name: Nurturing Haftrope
description: Read the marks on the floor that the opponent has taken and what they say of the next move.

name: Inferno Overhew
description: Hew twice in the order of the court with qi carried across both strokes.

name: Entropy Greatpoll
description: Hook the beard over the opponent's weapon and pull it from their grip in the court's manner.

name: Gloom Doubleedge
description: Press against an opponent's guard so that every reply they offer is the court's chosen reply.

name: Axetroth
description: Turn aside a blow and answer it at once with the cheek of the head and a short chop.

name: Steeltimber
description: Cleave in the full order of the court with qi laid down through each beat of the stroke.

name: Thunderclap Poleshoe
description: Fall like a pillar of the court on the opponent's guard and drive it into the floor.

name: Renddecree
description: Rend with the court's last edge so that the field carries the cut through guard and armor.

name: Intrepid Thunderclap Splitmass
description: The school's own stroke: one great axe delivers a pair of cuts so closely joined that the court sees only one.

name: Wideswell Edict
description: Rise on the toes and chop down in a short fall to the foe's floor.

name: Deluge Heavyeye
description: Step down from a raised stance onto the low ground in a single fall of the body.

name: Pealaxe
description: Rise in the stance and read the whole basin of the foe's position from above.

name: Bedrock Overhew
description: Hew from a high stance into the floor of the foe's stance with a falling edge.

name: Gloomgreat
description: Keep the head poised above the foe's guard and press it down toward the floor.

name: Devout Longhelve
description: Throw the arms wide and turn aside a blow with the haft as a wing turns the air.

name: Steel Rend
description: Fall from the height of the stoop into the basin of the foe's stance with the whole field behind the edge.

name: Timberverdict
description: Hold at the top of the rise while the field gathers and cleave down to the floor.

name: Bedrock Rend
description: Sunder the basin of the foe's stance with a fall driven by the qi field from above.

name: Vaunted Riven Edict
description: The school's own stroke: the hawk falls from the height and the ground rises to meet the edge in one blow.

name: Majestic Haftrope
description: Chop down on a single line and let the stroke continue to the end of its fall.

name: Squallriven
description: Step down a slope with the axe and let the angle of the ground add to the stroke.

name: Tranquil Greatbeard
description: Read the line from the raised axe to the foe and check it is clear before the fall.

name: Heavyeye Triumph
description: Hew in a smooth descent with qi following the edge and no break at the midpoint.

name: Sainted Greatpoll
description: Turn aside a blow down the slope of the haft as a hillside turns a falling stone.

name: Valiant Riven
description: Hold the descending head against the foe's guard and press it down the slope of the stance.

name: Haemal Doubleedge
description: Cleave in one unbroken descent with qi poured into the edge from the first lift to the last.

name: Steel Poleshoe
description: Fall without a pause from the top to the end of the stroke and crush the guard beneath.

name: Haftbell Verdict
description: Rend a defended line with the core's qi driving the long descent through guard and ground.

name: Gallant Thunderclap Overhew
description: The school's own stroke: a single fall that is begun once and carried on by the core until it lands.

name: Haemal Hewfall
description: Chop at the edge of the plateau with the oath held in mind and the feet planted.

name: Wraithlike Sunder
description: Pace out the line of the oath with an even stride across the plateau grass.

name: Reminiscence Haftrope
description: Read the direction of the plateau wind and take a bearing from it before the stroke.

name: Bedrock Longhelve
description: Hew with qi sworn behind the stroke so that its line is not altered by the foe.

name: Timbervow
description: Turn a blow aside and let the wind off the plateau edge carry it away.

name: Peal Greatpoll
description: Hook the beard around the opponent's guard and drag it along the sworn line.

name: Steel Heavyeye
description: Hew with the full strength of the body along the oath's line with the wind lending weight to the head.

name: Steelgreat
description: Bring the sworn weight of the head down on the foe's guard to crush it where it stands.

name: Prism Splitmass
description: Rend the guard with an oath-held edge that the field drives through the target's cover.

name: Vaunted Greatbit
description: The school's own stroke: one cut sworn to the plateau wind and delivered along the line of the oath.

name: Exalted Doubleedge
description: Chop along a taken bearing without letting the edge drift from its line.

name: Delugerend
description: Step with the wind and keep the bearing on the foe unchanged through the move.

name: Greatbit Largesse
description: Check the bearing against the foe's motion and read whether it still holds.

name: Thunderclap Rend
description: Hew along the held bearing with qi that keeps the edge true in every exchange.

name: Squall Haftbell
description: Parry across the bearing and turn the foe's blade out of line with a quick pulse of qi.

name: Peal Riven
description: Hook the beard onto the foe's weapon and drag it off the bearing it was held on.

name: Gloom Hewfall
description: Lay the weight of the head on the foe's guard along the bearing and press it down.

name: Vigor Greatbeard
description: Hew with the full body on the held bearing and let qi carry the head through any guard in its way.

name: Vigor Poleshoe
description: Fall along the bearing and crush the guard with the whole weight of the stroke.

name: Royal Riven
description: Rend a guard on the held bearing with the field driving the edge through without correction.

name: Haemalsunder
description: The school's own stroke: a bearing held on the foe through every exchange until the wind itself turns.

name: Triumphant Greatpoll
description: Chop with the head lifted and swung by the wind so the arms only guide its fall.

name: Haftbell Voyage
description: Step windward and let the wind take the weight of the axe off the shoulders.

name: Serene Wideswell
description: Feel how the wind passes along the edge and know the direction the cut will take.

name: Fearless Sunder
description: Hew with the wind bearing the head and a small pulse of qi to steer it onto the foe.

name: Deluge Longhelve
description: Parry with the head as the wind lifts it across and turn the blow from the body.

name: Seasonriven
description: Press the head against the foe's guard from the windward side so the wind bears down with it.

name: Bedrock Sunder
description: Cleave with the wind bearing the whole weight and the wielder holding only the line of the stroke.

name: Illustrious Splitmass
description: Fall onto the guard like a limb the wind has brought down and crush what is beneath.

name: Fearless Wideswell
description: Rend a guard with the wind-borne weight of the head and the field driving it through.

name: Vigor Greatbit
description: The school's own stroke: the wielder lets go of the weight and the wind brings it down on the foe.

name: Squall Doubleedge
description: Chop from a stance with open air behind it and the oath held firm in the stroke.

name: Deluge Overhew
description: Step onto the very edge of the sworn ground and refuse to give back any of it.

name: Ironclad Greatbeard
description: Cross the haft over the body in the open and take a blow with both hands.

name: Pealtimber
description: Read the gap between the foe's oath and their stance to find where the stroke will tell.

name: Axeverdict
description: Hew in the open with qi in the edge and no wall behind the body to lean on.

name: Stately Heavyeye
description: Parry a flanking blow with the haft and turn to meet it on the sworn line.

name: Entropy Poleshoe
description: Hook the beard around the foe's guard in the open and drag it out of their line.

name: Timbercrown
description: Press the head against the foe's guard and bear down with the oath as the only support.

name: Vaunted Greatbeard
description: Hew with all the body's strength in the open with qi in the edge and the oath behind it.

name: Squall Haftrope
description: Fall onto the foe on open ground with a weight the oath holds steady until the guard breaks.

name: Sundercrown
description: Rend a guard with an oath-held edge on open ground and the field driving the stroke through.

name: Gallant Wideswell Crown
description: The school's own stroke: one cut delivered on open ground that holds its line though nothing stands behind it.

name: Vigor Hewfall
description: Chop into the gale with the stroke sworn to ride it and not be turned.

name: Dunesunder
description: Step with the gale at the back and let the oath fix the line of the advance.

name: Greatgift
description: Read the gale's bend around the foe and judge the strength of the stroke it will bring.

name: Triumphant Haftbell
description: Hew with the sworn gale at the back so the head crosses the guard before it can close.

name: Parity Longhelve
description: Turn a blow with the haft and let the sworn gale draw it past the body.

name: Millstone Splitmass
description: Press down on the foe's guard with a gale's steady weight until they cannot lift.

name: Paramount Hewfall
description: Cleave on the gale's line with the full field and no break in the stroke.

name: Quenched Rend
description: Fall with the whole weight of the gale carried in the head and crush the raised guard.

name: Pulsar Greatbit
description: Rend the foe's guard with a stroke the gale drives through while the field holds the edge.

name: Quenched Haftrope
description: The school's own stroke: a great cut loosed only when the gale itself has taken up the oath.

name: Quenched Doubleedge
description: Chop from the open plateau with nothing built behind the stance to lean on.

name: Soundless Sunder
description: Pace across the plateau at even length so the axe stays ready at every moment.

name: Pealgreat
description: Look to the far horizon for the foes who are coming and read how fast they close.

name: Haemalgreat
description: Hew with the whole body and the core's qi in a stance that needs no wall.

name: Enshrined Poleshoe
description: Turn aside a flanking blow with the haft and swing to meet the new foe.

name: Noble Greatpoll
description: Hold the line of the plateau against a press of foes with heavy strokes from the shoulders.

name: Squall Overhew
description: Cleave across the open plateau with core qi in the edge and the whole body behind it.

name: Steel Splitmass
description: Bring the head down so hard that the ground of the plateau cracks beneath the blow.

name: Overhew Crown
description: Rend a guard in the open with a core-driven edge that holds the plateau after it falls.

name: Squallrend
description: The school's own stroke: one great cut from a standing axe that holds the plateau without walls.
